emily(sec): Auditor asked for a compact bundle: RBAC change workflow mapped to SOC2/ISO controls, KMS rotation + rewrap/unseal events for 24 months, and proof that service-account privilege escalations were reviewed. Can we scope and ETA? @omar @kevin

omar(infra): Scope: control map (single page), RBAC PR index (links + approvers), rolebinding diffs, CI smoke-test snippets proving least-privilege checks, KMS metadata (CreateDate, RotationStatus, LastUsed), and sign-off PDFs for manual unseal/rewrap. No key material in package. ETA 48 hours.

jane(auditor): For the KMS artifacts we need: event list showing ReEncrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls, approver identity for manual operations, and key policy snapshots. A small attestation from security confirming emergency unseals were authorized is required. Redaction is fine as long as you include a redaction map under NDA.

kevin(eng): I'll export a CI job snippet that runs `kubectl auth can-i` checks against a temporary role. Example snippet I'll include:
```
# ci excerpt
kubectl apply -f tmp/test-role.yaml --dry-run=server
kubectl auth can-i get secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:team:deploy:ci
```
Also adding `git --no-pager log --pretty=oneline -- cluster/rolebindings` and a sample `git diff` for a recent PR.

omar(infra): Splunk query for KMS unwraps I'll run: `index=aws_kms action IN (Decrypt, ReEncrypt, GenerateDataKey) | spath event.userIdentity, event.detail.keyId | table _time, event.userIdentity.arn, event.detail.keyId, eventName` . Exported JSON will replace ARNs with `u:####` tokens and include `redaction-map.csv` mapping tokens to internal IDs.

emily(sec): Important: include vendor EKM notes (we use ThalesCloud EKM) — snapshots of the vendor audit export (where allowed) and a note where HSM logs live. No vendor credentials. I'll prepare a one-paragraph attestation (GPG-signed) referencing ticket SEC-2026-888 stating emergency unseal was one-time and rotation occurred within 48 hours.

evidence-bot: evidence: prepackage checksums generated (run id: ev-1799991111-01). Files expected: control-map.md, rbac-prs.csv, role-diffs/, kms-events.json.gz, attestations/attestation-gpg.txt, redaction-map.csv.

omar(infra): Packaging plan: put evidence tarball at s3://audit-temp/evidence-1799991111.tar.gz with `manifest.txt` listing SHA256s. I'll include `index.csv` mapping artifacts to control IDs (SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9.2).

jane(auditor): That works. Please also add a short vuln note if any KMS helpers were patched in scope (one-paragraph with PR link). We need detective + preventive evidence.

kevin(eng): Noted. There's a small fix in kms-helper (PR #5012) — I'll include a triage summary in `vuln-triage/`.

omar(infra): ETA: Splunk slice + redacted JSON in ~2 hours, RBAC PR list + CI snippets in ~4 hours, full tarball within 48h. I'll post presigned link here when uploaded.

emily(sec): I'll review the manifest and sign attestation before upload. Ping me if anything blocks.

jane(auditor): Thanks team, please drop presigned URL here once ready. :thumbsup:
